scope: F2 fold-0 screen. Label-free passenger clustering on covariates + context-specific models per cluster.

H53_CONDITIONAL_CLUSTERING.question: Does label-free passenger clustering on covariates followed by cluster-specific models improve fold-0 OOF AUC?
H53_CONDITIONAL_CLUSTERING.method: Cross-fit: K-means clustering on covariates (folds 1-4), assign cluster labels to fold-0. Train separate LGBM per cluster on folds 1-4, predict fold-0. Aggregate predictions. LGBM fold-0 vs single global LGBM.
H53_CONDITIONAL_CLUSTERING.leakage: Clustering fit on FIT only (folds 1-4). Cluster assignment for fold-0. Per-cluster models trained on FIT only. Fold-safe.
H53_CONDITIONAL_CLUSTERING.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
